title: Blowhorn social links
description: data/social_links.json: Blowhorn's own public profiles, listed in order as icon links under the footer tagline (layouts/_partials/footer.html). Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

links.description: One entry per profile, in display order.

name.description: The platform's name, used as the link's accessible name.

url.description: Blowhorn's public profile on the platform.

icon.description: The platform owner's logo, a path under static/ (static/assets/platforms/), used as the file.
